title: SAC LA 20-storey pre-Northridge MRF (N-S frame), Ohtori et al. 2004

source.citation: Ohtori, Christenson, Spencer, Dyke (2004). Benchmark Control Problems for Seismically Excited Nonlinear Buildings. J. Eng. Mech. 130(4):366-385.
source.where: Report_bldg_full3.pdf p.12 (natural frequencies of the evaluation model); model data struct20.m and Bld_NLBM.m in Files_bldg_full3.zip, NEES database doi:10.4231/D3Q52FC7T
source.independence: Published by the benchmark authors from their own MATLAB model; not computed by stabileo or by this generator.

modelling: Euler-Bernoulli plane frame, nodes at beam-column joints, no panel zones (as the source).
Sections back-computed from the source's EI1 and EA with E = 200000 MPa.
Rigid floor: equalDOF on ux between each level's master and slave nodes (source's slv_tbl).
Lumped masses (m/2 per beam end, both translations) carried by mass-only truss stubs; the source's ~1e-6 rotational masses are omitted.
Total lumped mass 6.069520e+06 kg (source: half the building's seismic mass).
